entities.name: Archenemy
entities.description: The villain role in the Archenemy product, a lone, flamboyantly resourced villain with schemes who is ganged up on by heroes.

entities.name: Doomsday Machine Artificer
entities.description: A visionary artificer archenemy obsessed with constructing a vast device of many artifact components.

entities.name: Necromancer Archenemy
entities.description: A necromancer archenemy who seeks to rule by the power of undeath, overrunning the living with undead creations.

entities.name: Druid Archenemy
entities.description: A wild druid archenemy bent on ripping down the excesses of civilized life with a natural army.

entities.name: Dragon Master
entities.description: A passionate archenemy who is either a master of dragons or a masterful dragon, bent on dragon-based mayhem.

events.summary: The column describes the necromancer archenemy's goal of overrunning the world of the living with undead creations.
events.quote: your game plan is to overrun the world of the living with your undead creations.

events.summary: The column describes the druid archenemy's goal of punishing civilization for its excesses with a natural army.
events.quote: a wild, instinct-driven (for the last time, you are not "mad"!) druid bent on ripping down the dismal overindulgences of "civilized" life.
